title: STAC Iceberg Extension
description: Extends STAC Collections with Apache Iceberg table access and versioning metadata.

oneOf.$comment: This is the schema for STAC Collections.

iceberg:catalog_type.description: Iceberg catalog backend type. 'sql', 'rest', 'glue', 'hive', and 'dynamodb' are Iceberg catalog implementations. 'static' is a Portolan convention, not an Iceberg-defined catalog type. It means a filesystem-style table layout (metadata.json plus Avro manifests, written with the Hadoop/filesystem layout) on object storage, read with no catalog server via PyIceberg StaticTable or DuckDB iceberg_scan, optionally fronted by a pre-rendered static REST surface that a client can ATTACH with no authentication.

iceberg:catalog_uri.description: Connection URI for the Iceberg catalog. For a static REST surface this is the base URL the REST endpoints are served under.

iceberg:rest_prefix.description: REST catalog prefix, the '{prefix}' path segment a client inserts into REST paths (v1/{prefix}/namespaces/...), obtained from the 'overrides' or 'defaults' in the GET /v1/config response. Needed only to ATTACH a prefixed REST surface. Example 'sdi'.

iceberg:authorization_type.description: Authorization mode a client should use to read the catalog. 'oauth2' and 'sigv4' are the schemes the Iceberg REST spec describes. 'none' is a Portolan convention meaning no client authentication, for a publicly readable catalog, it is not an Iceberg-defined mode.

iceberg:metadata_location.description: URL of the table's current metadata.json. The most direct handle for a serverless reader, usable with DuckDB iceberg_scan() or PyIceberg StaticTable without a catalog.

iceberg:format_version.description: Iceberg format version. Version 3 is the first version with native geometry/geography types and CRS, so geospatial tables described by this extension are v3 or later.

iceberg:current_snapshot_id.description: Current snapshot ID for reproducibility. Iceberg snapshot IDs are 64-bit, so this is serialized as a string to avoid precision loss in JSON parsers (e.g. JavaScript) that round integers above 2^53.

iceberg:partition_spec.description: Iceberg partition fields, mirroring the table's current partition spec. Omit for unpartitioned tables.

name.description: Partition field name as it appears in the Iceberg partition spec. This is the partition field name, which may differ from the source column name.

transform.description: Iceberg partition transform. One of 'identity', 'void', 'year', 'month', 'day', 'hour', or the parameterized forms 'bucket[N]' and 'truncate[W]' (the bracketed parameter is required, e.g. 'bucket[16]').

source-id.description: Field ID of the source column the transform is applied to (Iceberg 'source-id').

field-id.description: Field ID assigned to this partition field (Iceberg 'field-id', 1000+ by convention).
